create_cosine_lr_scheduler: create a CosineSchedule LR scheduler with args and optimizer for training
configure_cosine_scheduler_args: configure cosine LR scheduler CLI arguments including warmup-updates, max-lr, and t-mult
update_lr_per_step: update the learning rate per epoch using the step method of CosineSchedule
update_lr_per_update: update the learning rate after each training update using step_update with num_updates
build_cosine_warmup_schedule: build a cosine learning rate schedule with linear warmup from warmup-init-lr to max-lr
